79721.subject: The Claude Code Projects Playbook: Make Claude Your Chief of Staff 🧠
79721.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/claude-code-projects-playbook

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 400k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
Anthropic’s redesigned Projects (in beta since September 17) lets one Claude Code conversation split a body of work into parallel threads that keep running after you close your laptop. The people who get the most from it set it up the way a firm runs an engagement. That means a clear brief, workstreams with named owners, a shared decision file, standing rules, review gates, and a budget. The people who get the least paste in just a vague goal. They (unsurprisingly) then come back to five overlapping pull requests and a usage window that ran out while they slept, because a thread that hits your plan limit resumes on its own when the limit resets.
Anthropic’s pitch is that you brief a project the way you’d brief a Chief of Staff. A project is now one ongoing conversation. You hand it work as it comes up, and Claude scopes it, splits it into threads, reviews what comes back, and assembles the result. Each thread is a full Claude Code [ https://substack.com/redirect/85f49e8a-b444-4285-bbca-0707e2fa97ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] session on its own branch, and every thread shares the project’s repositories, instructions, and memory. You can check in and steer from your phone.
Inside Anthropic, the reaction has been enthusiastic. Frank Lee, a member of Anthropic’s technical staff, wrote that the new coordinator “unlocked a totally different mode of working” for him. It felt, he said, like “having a chief of staff dedicated to each thing you’re working on.” Dickson Tsai, who works on Claude Code, says it moved him off the command line and into Claude Desktop full time.
Outside Anthropic, the reception has been cooler. The Register headlined its launch story as a way to “work and pay in parallel.” A Windows Forum analysis warned that parallel threads still produce merge conflicts and pull requests that don’t fit together, leaving human review as the bottleneck. And in Anthropic’s own compiler experiment [ https://substack.com/redirect/e9282f80-1d54-4150-8464-f39f5ffc289e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], 16 agents working in parallel hit the same bug and kept overwriting each other’s fixes until the work was split differently.
What separates those two pictures is mostly setup and discipline. It pays to get them right early. Access is expanding to more Pro and Max accounts as we speak; the same model is coming to Claude chat and Cowork [ https://substack.com/redirect/bc0e8406-3434-4558-8ec5-14cbe7bb0f72?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] next, and the habits you set in your first projects carry into every thread after them

79712.subject: Have you generated your Recovery Kit?
79712.body:
Your Passkey lives on
your device. A Recovery Kit is your backup if you ever lose
access.

*****************************************************************
SECURE YOUR
WALLET.
*****************************************************************

Hi
Novosadov oleh,

There's one
quick thing that keeps your Socios.com account safe for the long
run: your Recovery Kit.

You already use your
Passkey, the Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN you created when
setting up your wallet to confirm all your wallet transactions
inside the app. To ensure you never lose access when switching or
upgrading devices, make sure cloud syncing is turned
on:

* iPhone: Turn on iCloud
Keychain in your Apple
settings.
* Android: Turn on Google
Password Manager in your Google
settings.
Your
Recovery Kit is the backstop for everything else. If you ever
lose access to your Passkey, it's the only way back into your
Wallet.

Generate
your Recovery Kit

We noticed you
haven't generated yours yet. Generating your Recovery Kit is the
only way to restore your Socios.com Wallet if you lose your
Passkey. Go to Account Management > Recovery Kit > Generate, then
store it somewhere safe.

Socios.com cannot
restore your Wallet or assets if both your Passkey and Recovery
Kit are lost.

*Ondo's tokenized assets are now on CoinList*

Tokenized US equities, ETFs, and commodities are now available to purchase directly on CoinList. The assets come from Ondo Stocks and can be bought and sold directly in your CoinList account, alongside token sales, so there is no separate platform or wallet to set up in order to hold them.

This is a curated selection rather than the full Ondo catalogue. The goal was to launch with a set that covers the exposures most people are actually looking for: recognizable US names, broad market index products, and commodities for diversification outside equities. More assets and funds will be added over time.

Buying US equities has traditionally required a US brokerage relationship and the eligibility requirements that come with it, which puts it out of reach for a large share of the people who want that exposure. CoinList, along with our partners like Ondo and Superstate, is excited to change that dynamic and offer tokenized RWAs to our users.

Ondo is the first of several platforms whose assets will be available on CoinList directly.
